system.description: You announce yourself (perhaps mentioning one of your intimidating deeds) to all foes within long range who can hear and understand you. Make a separate Intellect attack roll for each foe. Success means they are afraid of you, easing your tasks against them until you use a ten-minute or longer recovery. Action.
